info.title: Kallfi ACR — Third-Party API
info.summary: Surface-aware ACR account commands and retained organization operations
info.description: Kallfi ACR account keys expose the canonical account Soul wizard, admitted media uploads, Post creation and generation, conversations, workflow reads, and Soul publishing and monetization. Account commands use normal product safety, quotas, account Gems, pricing and lifecycle owners before Enterprise purchase. The seven earlier organization operations retain their existing IDs, scopes, grant rules and organization economy for compatibility. COM and RED account keys are distinct and must match the registered request host. Canonical origins are https://acr.kallfi.com/v1 and https://acr.kallfi.red/v1; api.kallfi.* aliases remain compatible. Documentation and source contracts do not establish hosted deployment, Vault migration, provider readiness, funded billing, or terminal product proof. Keep bearer keys in server secret managers.

IdempotencyKey.description: Opaque replay key for this mutation. Repeating the same key with the same request returns the original result; reusing it with different input returns a conflict.

SourceAssetAccepted.description: Accepted. The upload intent and its asynchronous validation operation are available.

SoulAccepted.description: Accepted. Soul creation continues as an asynchronous operation.

SoulUpdateAccepted.description: Accepted. The revision-checked Soul update continues as an asynchronous operation.

ResponseAccepted.description: Accepted. Response generation continues as an asynchronous operation.

GenerationAccepted.description: Accepted. Image or video generation continues as an asynchronous operation.

BadRequest.description: The request is malformed or violates the JSON contract.

Unauthorized.description: Authentication is missing, invalid, expired, or revoked.

Forbidden.description: The credential is authenticated but not authorized for this company-scoped resource or capability.

NotFound.description: The company-scoped resource does not exist or is not visible to this credential.

Conflict.description: The replay key conflicts with a different request, the requested revision/capability cannot converge, or a surface-owned resource/operation was addressed with a different surface. UnprocessableEntity.description: The request is structurally valid but fails a safety, rights, consent, capability, quote, or domain invariant.

TooManyRequests.description: The organization or service is over a bounded rate, concurrency, outstanding-operation, or spend limit.

Retry-After.description: Minimum delay in seconds before retrying, when known.

ServiceUnavailable.description: The proposed service cannot currently admit this request or a required capability is unavailable. No billable successful operation is created.

OperationBase.description: Common operation fields. The concrete operation schema adds its kind discriminant and, for surface-owned work, its immutable surface.

SharedOperation.description: Surface-neutral operation for source-asset validation or shared Soul identity work. It must omit surface.

SurfaceOwnedOperation.description: Surface-owned response or generation operation. Its surface is required and immutable after acceptance.

surface.description: Immutable surface derived from the accepted request.

Operation.description: Concrete operation union. Shared source-asset and Soul identity operations omit surface; response and generation operations require their immutable surface.
